args.description: A medieval standard-bearer on foot, on a transparent background, seen from high above at a steep angle. He holds a tall pole with a LARGE simple rectangular banner in one flat bold CRIMSON RED, no pattern and no emblem on it, the banner filling much of the image and reading clearly at tiny size. Plain steel helm and mail, dark outline. No ground, no grass, no sky.
